description: This file contains repository functions for managing dealer-related data and financial transactions in a dealer management system using SQLAlchemy ORM. It includes functions for creating, listing, and retrieving dealers, as well as creating and summarizing stock entries, payroll credits, payments, and generating various financial reports and activity feeds.

methods.name: Dealer create_dealer(db: Session, *, name: str, phone: str | None, address: str | None)
methods.description: Creates a new dealer record with provided name, phone, and address.

methods.name: list[Dealer] list_dealers(db: Session)
methods.description: Retrieves all dealer records ordered by name.

methods.name: Dealer|None get_dealer(db: Session, dealer_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a dealer record by its ID.

methods.name: StockEntry create_stock_entry( db: Session, *, dealer_id: int, item_name: str, quantity: int, unit_cost: Decimal, stock_date: dt.date | None, )
methods.description: Creates a stock entry for a dealer, calculating total cost from unit cost and quantity.

methods.name: PayrollCredit create_payroll_credit( db: Session, *, dealer_id: int, description: str | None, amount: Decimal, credit_date: dt.date | None, )
methods.description: Creates a payroll or credit record for a dealer with optional description and date.

methods.name: Payment create_payment( db: Session, *, dealer_id: int, amount: Decimal, paid_at: dt.datetime | None, note: str | None, )
methods.description: Records a payment made by a dealer, with optional note and payment date.

methods.name: dict[str,Decimal]|None compute_dealer_ledger_summary(db: Session, dealer_id: int)
methods.description: Calculates ledger summary totals for a specific dealer, including stock total, payroll credits, payments, and balance due.

methods.name: dict[str,Decimal] compute_finance_totals(db: Session)
methods.description: Computes overall financial totals across all dealers and entries, including stock value, credits, payments, and outstanding balance.

methods.name: list[dict] list_finance_per_dealer_summaries(db: Session, *, limit: int, offset: int)
methods.description: Provides paginated summaries per dealer with totals and counts of stocks, credits, payments, and outstanding balance.

methods.name: list[dict] list_finance_activity(db: Session, *, limit: int, offset: int)
methods.description: Provides a combined, recent activity feed across stock entries, credits, and payments for dashboard or audit purposes.
